newsitem.title: UK: Brit Midland 1996 figures boosted by tunnel fire.
newsitem.headline: Brit Midland 1996 figures boosted by tunnel fire.

text.p: British Midland reported a seven percent rise in its 1996 passenger figures on Thursday, with the numbers inflated to record levels by the closure of the Channel Tunnel after a fire in November.

Sir Michael Bishop, chairman of the short-haul European carrier, told a press briefing that the reduction in services through Eurotunnel's Channel Tunnel had inflated British Midland's revenues by two-and-a-half to three million stg in the period from mid-November to the end of January.
